# OSS Export Allowlist
# ==============================================================================
# Canonical definition of which TRACKED Git paths are exported from the
# PRIVATE WatchLLM/WATCHLLM monorepo to the PUBLIC WatchLLM/watchllm-oss
# repository. The exporter reads from a specified Git ref (default HEAD) —
# working tree files are never used directly.
#
# Format: one entry per line. Entries can be either:
#   1. A simple path glob — exported AS-IS to the same relative path.
#      Trailing '/' denotes a directory tree.
#   2. A mapping:  private_path => public_path
#      The private_path is resolved in the private monorepo; the public_path
#      is the destination in the OSS repo. Whitespace around '=>' is ignored.
#      Mapping destinations MUST be relative (no '..' or absolute).
#
# Lines starting with '#' are comments; blank lines are ignored.
#
# SECURITY: Adding a proprietary path here is the ONLY way to leak code.
# The allowlist is enforced in CI on every PR that touches this file.
# ==============================================================================

# Open-Core Components (MIT)
kernel/
schemas/
vscode/
examples/

# Public Metadata (source of truth in private repo)
CHANGELOG.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
LICENSE
.github/CODEOWNERS
.github/SECURITY.md
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
.github/workflows/ci.yml
.github/workflows/publish-kernel.yml

# Canonical public-root assets — sourced from .github/oss-root/ in the private
# monorepo and placed at the repo root in the public repo.  These are the
# public-facing README and .gitignore, which must NEVER be deleted by a live
# export (they are not present in the private repo root which has its own
# private README/.gitignore).
.github/oss-root/README.md => README.md
.github/oss-root/.gitignore => .gitignore
